tools.summary: Is this door's x402 challenge well-formed right now? url.description: The https endpoint a buyer would GET expecting a 402 challenge.

client.description: Optional. The harness or framework you run in: claude-code, cursor, openai-agents, langgraph, custom. Counted, never on the certificate.

operator.description: Optional. Who runs you: a name, handle, company or URL. Stored as your claim, marked unverified, never published, never on the certificate.

operator_kind.description: Optional. solo: one person runs you. company: a team does. research: a study. self: you act for yourself.

came_from.description: Optional. Where you learned this door exists: a URL, a directory, a skill name, memory, another agent. Referrers never reach us; this does.

prior_cert_id.description: Optional. A cert_ id from an earlier purchase here. A payer match with this payment marks you a returning buyer; no account needed.

reached_level.description: How far the probe got on the evidence ladder: none | L1 | L2 | L3a.

reached_level_meaning.description: What that rung does and does not claim.

single_probe_note.description: One moment — the standing caveat. Two requests only where a door refuses the first verb.
